what: The SLOOP groovebox for the M-VAVE FM-1, forked for dub: a four-band isolator with mute bands, a bipolar DJ filter, per-track echo throws, a tape echo with free time or synced divisions, an independent siren voice, skank, accents and slides — with a sound-system bank of 180 genre presets (ska to ragga jungle, plus the Casio MT-40's 22 tones), 38 drum kits including the MT-40's rhythm unit and 28 riddims that each load with their four patterns (bass, skanks, melody, drums) — the classics every sound system grew up on (Heavenless, Tonight, Get in the Groove, Hot Milk, Answer, Promised Land, Gunman, Here I Come, the Sleng Teng at their head with the preset's verified stuttering bass, and the other ten's bass lines transcribed from the records themselves) plus the MT-40's five other auto-rhythms — over the base SLOOP engines and FM6.
author: altessproduction
